## Checklist

- [ ] One self-contained `.html` file, under 2 MB
- [ ] Runs from `file://` with the wifi off — no CDN, no `fetch`, no external images
- [ ] Legible in light and dark, usable at 390px
- [ ] `meta.yaml` has exactly one `style` and 1–2 `use_case` values from `taxonomy.yaml`
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] I made this myself and can license it as declared
- [ ] No third-party logos, game clones, lyrics, or copyrighted images
